is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: This is a study protocol paper. It describes the planned methodology for monitoring insecticide resistance markers (e.g., Vgsc, CYP6 genes) but does not report any actual genotype data or results.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper is a study protocol and does not contain any empirical genotype data.

african_field_population.evidence: The study is conducted in the Zou department, Benin (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study protocol.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study is located in Cove, Zagnanado, and Ouinhi Districts, Zou department, Benin (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new study protocol.

supplement.evidence: The paper is a protocol and does not contain empirical data.

assessment.summary: This paper is a study protocol for a cluster-randomized controlled trial in Benin to evaluate the efficacy of two dual-active ingredient LLINs (Interceptor G2 and Royal Guard) compared to a standard pyrethroid-only LLIN. As it is a protocol paper, it does not report any empirical genotype data or results.
